topic.source_contract: designation, geological feature, boundary, evidence, condition, sensitivity, consultation, mitigation, management, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: A geological-interest map is not treated as a designated Local Geological Site.
A designation is not treated as a statutory SSSI.
A regional bedrock unit is not treated as the exact exposed feature.
A desk study is not treated as verified site condition.
A mitigation proposal is not treated as preserved geological interest.
Planning permission is not treated as completed conservation works.
Site access is not treated as long-term management and monitoring.
No score or promotion is written without exact boundary, feature, condition, decision, mitigation, management and monitoring evidence.
row_checks: Correct local site partnership or authority required
Current selected, proposed or deleted status required
Stratigraphy, palaeontology, geomorphology or mineralogy required
Local, regional and national context required
Development, infill, vegetation and erosion required
Exact footprint and influence area required
Cut, fill and foundation effects required
Groundwater and geomorphological process effects required
Geological specialists and site body required
Exposure creation, protection and interpretation required
Long-term clearance, access and safety required
Condition indicators and remedial action required
Map, policy or strategy alone is not exact-site delivery
Application or proposal is not approval
Funding announcement is not completed delivery
Current operational use or service required
